text: In an age of globalisation and rapid technological change, there is a debate about what should happen to traditional customs and festivals. Some people think that they will inevitably disappear, whereas others believe that they must be protected. I will discuss both views before giving my own opinion.

Those who think that traditions cannot survive point out that modern life has changed people's priorities. Young people spend a lot of time on their phones and are influenced by global trends in music, fashion and food, so they may feel that old customs are boring or irrelevant. Furthermore, many families now live in cities far from their relatives, which makes it difficult to celebrate festivals together as in the past. As a result, some festivals have become commercial events that are celebrated mainly for entertainment, and their original meaning is gradually forgotten.

On the other hand, I believe that traditions are valuable and can be preserved with some effort. They give people a sense of identity and connect different generations. For example, in Kazakhstan, the spring festival of Nauryz is still celebrated by millions of people, and schools often organise concerts and traditional games for children. Governments can also support craftspeople and museums, and tourists are often interested in local culture, which gives communities a reason to keep their customs alive. Moreover, the internet can help, because videos and social media can introduce traditional music and dances to young people in an attractive way.

In conclusion, although modern life makes it harder to maintain traditional customs, I believe they should be protected. With support from schools, families and governments, old traditions can adapt to the modern world and continue to bring people together.

strengths.en: The paragraphs are logically organised and the linking devices help the reader follow the ideas.

note.en: Introduction: paraphrases the task and says what the writing will cover, without unnecessary detail.
note.kk: Кіріспе абзац: тапсырманы өз сөзімен айтып, не туралы екенін қысқа хабарлайды.
note.ru: Вводный абзац: перефразирует задание и сообщает, о чём пойдёт речь, без лишних деталей.

note.en: Body paragraph: one main idea, its development, and a concrete example or argument.
note.kk: Негізгі абзац: бір басты ой, оның дамуы және нақты мысал немесе дәлел.
note.ru: Основной абзац: одна главная мысль, её развитие и конкретный пример или аргумент.
